description: beehiiv is a newsletter publishing platform for creators, publishers, and brands. It provides tools to create, distribute, grow, and monetize newsletters, along with websites, automations, podcasts, analytics, and related audience features.
summary: beehiiv exposes a REST API at `https://api.beehiiv.com/v2` authenticated by API keys or OAuth2 bearer tokens, plus two MCP endpoints: an authenticated developer MCP server at `https://developers.beehiiv.com/_mcp/server` and a public pricing MCP endpoint at `https://www.beehiiv.com/api/mcp`.
